explication: v2rayA is a web-managed V2Ray/Xray client for protocol proxying and system-wide transparent proxying. A user configures servers, routing, DNS, and tunnel behavior in the GUI; API controllers validate and persist those settings, then the process manager generates or starts the core and installs platform networking rules. Traffic is routed through proxy or direct paths, while DNS queries are separately classified, cached, and sent upstream. The sampled source confirms these central flows; some controller-to-runtime links are represented only where the tree and documented behavior support them.
